stem.text: A car of mass $1500\,\text{kg}$ travels at a constant velocity of $30\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ down a slope. The slope is at an angle of $6.0^{\circ}$ to the horizontal, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a car on a slope inclined at 6.0° to the horizontal, labelled car, mass 1500 kg; a constant velocity of 30 m s-1 arrow pointing down the slope; and a resistive force arrow of 2000 N pointing up the slope.

stem.text: The magnitude of the total resistive force acting on the car is $2000\,\text{N}$.
What is the power output of the car’s engine?
